refnamediv.refpurpose: Accept a connection on a socket created by stream_socket_server

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
socket
The server socket to accept a connection from.
timeout
Override the default socket accept timeout. Time should be given in seconds. By default, default_socket_timeout is used. A negative value makes the call wait indefinitely, and 0 only checks once for a pending connection and fails at once otherwise.
peer_name
Will be set to the name (address) of the client which connected, if included and available from the selected transport.
Can also be determined later using stream_socket_get_name.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns a stream to the accepted socket connection&return.falseforfailure;. If no connection arrives in time, an E_WARNING (Accept failed) is emitted and &false; is returned.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if timeout is not a finite value (NAN, INF or -INF).
